WITH ec AS (SELECT nro_establecimiento, MAX(nombre_fantasia) AS nf 
  FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento 
  WHERE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(cuit_establecimiento_host,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)
  GROUP BY nro_establecimiento),
trx AS (
  SELECT TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS nroest,
    CAST(date_parse(concat(a.fechalocalautorizacion,a.horalocalautorizacion),'%y%m%d%H%i%s') AS timestamp)+INTERVAL '3' HOUR AS ts,
    TRIM(a.codrespuestaautorizacion) AS cr,
    TRIM(a.codtipomensajeautorizacion) AS cmsg,
    TRIM(a.codprocesoautorizacion1) AS cproc
  FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.ctx_autorizaciones_eps a
  WHERE a.fecha BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeFrom()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ec WHERE TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER)=ec.nro_establecimiento)
    AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}') AND ('${bin:raw}'='' OR substr(regexp_extract(TRIM(a.nrotarjeta),'^[0-9]+'),1,8)='${bin:raw}') AND (TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) NOT IN (SELECT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE e.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(REPLACE(e.cuit_establecimiento_host,'-','') AS BIGINT) IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))) AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('VD','VK','V6','VB','VN','SR','VC') THEN 'Visa' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('MD','MC','MS','MK') THEN 'Mastercard' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='AX' THEN 'Amex' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='PA' THEN 'Cabal' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='UC' THEN 'UPI' ELSE 'Otra' END) IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR CAST(TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END) IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))
),
act AS (
  SELECT nroest,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aprob,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deneg
  FROM trx
  WHERE ts>=$__timeFrom() AND ts<$__timeTo() AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cproc NOT IN('92','30')
  GROUP BY nroest
),
base AS (
  SELECT TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS nroest,
    ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(a.codrespuestaautorizacion) IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS taa_base
  FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.ctx_autorizaciones_eps a
  WHERE a.fecha BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('day',-1,$__timeFrom())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('day',-1,$__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d')

    AND TRIM(a.codtipomensajeautorizacion)<>'1420' AND TRIM(a.codprocesoautorizacion1) NOT IN('92','30')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ec WHERE TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER)=ec.nro_establecimiento)
    AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}') AND ('${bin:raw}'='' OR substr(regexp_extract(TRIM(a.nrotarjeta),'^[0-9]+'),1,8)='${bin:raw}') AND (TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento) AS INTEGER) NOT IN (SELECT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE e.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(REPLACE(e.cuit_establecimiento_host,'-','') AS BIGINT) IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))) AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('VD','VK','V6','VB','VN','SR','VC') THEN 'Visa' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP IN('MD','MC','MS','MK') THEN 'Mastercard' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='AX' THEN 'Amex' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='PA' THEN 'Cabal' WHEN a.INSTRMTYP='UC' THEN 'UPI' ELSE 'Otra' END) IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR CAST(TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END) IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))
  GROUP BY TRIM(a.nroestablecimiento)
)
SELECT 
  act.nroest AS "Establecimiento",
  COALESCE(ec.nf, act.nroest) AS "Nombre",
  act.total AS "Total TRX",
  act.deneg AS "Denegadas",
  ROUND(100.0*act.aprob/NULLIF(act.total,0),2) AS "TAA %",
  base.taa_base AS "Baseline D-1 %",
  ROUND(ROUND(100.0*act.aprob/NULLIF(act.total,0),2) - base.taa_base, 1) AS "Δpp"
FROM act 
LEFT JOIN ec ON TRY_CAST(act.nroest AS INTEGER)=ec.nro_establecimiento
LEFT JOIN base ON act.nroest=base.nroest
ORDER BY act.deneg DESC
LIMIT 100;
